title: An open question: the most underappreciated market risk in 2026
summary: This clip is a five-second question with no lesson content. The speaker asks viewers which market risk for 2026 they think is most underappreciated. The chart shows why risk planning matters: a large loss needs a much larger gain to recover.

steps.caption: The transcript only asks a question. This chart is a general reference on downside risk.
The gain needed to recover rises faster than the loss: a 50% loss needs a 100% gain.
A 30% loss needs about a 43% gain to get back to even.

takeaways: The clip asks which market risk in 2026 is most underappreciated and gives no answer.
Planning for unexpected risks matters because losses compound against you.
